notes: S1-FIX4 W1/§11.5 rule 1: the previous manifest is signed by a device key whose declaration exists only inside the previous container. The previous container's own records are never part of the verification context, so the key is not a required key of the target context and the link fails: invalid E_MANIFEST_CHAIN. The previous signature was not re-verified, so N_PREVIOUS_SIG_UNVERIFIED/L_PREVIOUS_SIG_UNVERIFIED are reported and L_PREVIOUS_CONTENT_UNVERIFIED is not.
